scope: User-authorized first learnability pilot before expanding the 24-exercise bank; no strength promotion

data.grouping: All related old/new roots and slices remain development; variants never count as unseen-family tests
data.rules: MR4 core without banlist; 40-card main decks, max 3 copies, normal draws and first-turn restrictions; fixed deals
data.target: Two Sword attacks clear two opposing Blue-Eyes; retain Hayate direct attack

teaching.loss: Equal capability-weighted demonstrated-action cross entropy on suffixes
teaching.history: Recompute full own-seat prefix under current parameters each update, full BPTT; no cached hidden states
teaching.early_stop: Nonfinite values, provenance mismatch, replay mismatch or budget exhausted

continuation_controls.common: Unmodified cleanba PPO, fixed SkyStriker self-play deck, common seed 8102026, normal terminal rewards; same native and assets
continuation_controls.learner_observation_budget_note: Extra 2048 PPO examples equal 32*32*2 padded teaching examples. This matches learner example count, not total FLOPs or wall time; teacher preparation and rollout costs reported separately.

evaluation.learnability_gate: All 3 normal position roots clear board with two Sword attacks, all 3 normal Hayate roots retain direct damage without own damage
evaluation.regression: Original successful synthetic Hayate direct attack remains successful
evaluation.full_game_strength: Not established by this pilot; broader held-out seeds/decks/seats/opponents required
